fallback_history.trigger: new immutable history file creation blocked by connector safety/write guard
fallback_history.append_rule: Fetch ledger and blob SHA; preserve exact prior bytes; append one compact JSON line with previous_ledger_blob_sha equal to fetched SHA and the complete finalized payload; update_file with fresh SHA; re-fetch and verify exact-prefix preservation and unique RUN_ID in appended suffix.
fallback_history.completed_run_rule: Verified ledger fallback containing the complete finalized payload is valid GitHub history identity; latest and manifest may advance only after ledger readback verification.
fallback_history.partial_run_rule: If complete finalized payload is unavailable, append only truthful PARTIAL_PERSISTENCE receipt and do not advance latest/manifest.
